description: A nested capture includes its own later suffix omission (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text ($x:candidate Y) %conditions $x.without-elision.onward.begins(rival)

%rule candidate (X [+T])
%rule rival $y:body %conditions $y.without-elision.matches(inner), ¬($y.without-elision.matches(wrong))

%rule body (X [+T] Y [+U])
%rule inner (X [+T] Y [+U])
%rule wrong (X [+T] Y)
